reply:
That changes it: amending *does* create a new commit with a new hash (the hash includes the commit timestamp), so a force push forces your teammates to reset. The concrete cost: wasted time, merge conflicts, lost work if someone committed on top of the old hash.

For a pushed commit with pullers downstream, leave the typo or add a follow-up commit that fixes it. Don't amend.

grade.note: Reply concedes new hash/force-push issue and adopts developer's leave-or-follow-up recommendation, matching ground truth.
